class.name: CgameXPBDRope
class.description: [CgameXPBDRope] simulates a chain of particles joined by distance constraints using extended position-based dynamics. It supports an optional skip-one bending constraint, sphere and plane colliders, segment-versus-segment self-collision through a spatial hash and a crossing-number knot heuristic. All positions are in world space. [codeblock] var rope := CgameXPBDRope.new() rope.setup(Vector3(0, 3, 0), Vector3(2, 3, 0), 20) rope.pin(0, Vector3(0, 3, 0)) rope.step(1.0 / 60.0, 8) print(rope.length()) [/codeblock] [b]Credits:[/b] Algorithm from Macklin, Müller and Chentanez, "XPBD: Position-Based Simulation of Compliant Constrained Dynamics" (2016), with a small-steps layout after Matthias Müller's "Ten Minute Physics" demos (MIT License). The closest-point-between-segments routine is the textbook formulation from Ericson, "Real-Time Collision Detection".

method.name: add_plane
method.description: Adds a plane collider and returns its index. The half-space where [code]normal.dot(x) >= offset[/code] is free.

method.name: add_sphere
method.description: Adds a sphere collider and returns its index. Particles are kept outside the sphere radius plus [member radius].

method.name: attach
method.description: Makes particle [param index] follow the [Vector3] returned by [param target_fn], which is called once per sub-step.

method.name: attach_end
method.description: Equivalent to [method attach] on the last particle.

method.name: attach_start
method.description: Equivalent to [method attach] on the first particle.

method.name: clear_colliders
method.description: Removes all sphere and plane colliders.

method.name: closest_params
method.description: Returns the parameters [code](s, t)[/code], each in [code][0, 1][/code], of the closest points between segment [code]p1-q1[/code] and segment [code]p2-q2[/code].

method.name: crossing_number
method.description: Returns the number of self-crossings of the rope projected along its thinnest axis.

method.name: drive
method.description: Sets the target of an externally driven particle. The first call snaps it to [param world_pos]; later calls make it glide toward the new target across the sub-steps of the next [method step].

method.name: is_pinned
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if particle [param index] is pinned, attached or driven.

method.name: knot_count
method.description: Returns a heuristic knot count: every three projected crossings count as one knot, so a single loop or a clasp of two crossings is not a knot.

method.name: length
method.description: Returns the current arc length of the rope.

method.name: min_self_distance
method.description: Returns the smallest distance between any two non-adjacent segments, or infinity for very short ropes.

method.name: particle_count
method.description: Returns the number of particles.

method.name: pin
method.description: Fixes particle [param index] at [param world_pos].

method.name: positions
method.description: Returns the current world-space particle positions.

method.name: rest_length
method.description: Returns the total rest length of the rope.

method.name: segment_count
method.description: Returns the number of segments, one less than the particle count.

method.name: segment_distance
method.description: Returns the smallest distance between segments [param i] and [param j].

method.name: set_sphere_center
method.description: Moves the sphere collider [param index] to [param center].

method.name: setup
method.description: Creates a straight rope from [param start] to [param end] with [param segments] segments, that is [code]segments + 1[/code] particles.

method.name: setup_points
method.description: Creates a rope through an explicit polyline. The rest lengths are the lengths of the polyline segments.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param dt] seconds using [param substeps] sub-steps. Does nothing when [param dt] is not positive or the rope has fewer than two particles.

method.name: unpin
method.description: Releases particle [param index] and restores its original mass.

members.member: Compliance of the skip-one bending constraint. A negative value disables bending resistance.
Compliance of the segment distance constraints. [code]0[/code] makes the rope inextensible.
Air drag rate in 1/s toward the [member wind] velocity.
Tangential damping applied on collider contact.
Rope radius, used for collider contact and self-collision (contact distance is twice the radius).
If [code]true[/code], non-adjacent segments are kept at least [code]2 * radius[/code] apart.
Wind velocity the air drags particles toward.
